description: Energy Efficiency Indicators is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy efficiency", published or maintained by IEA (International Energy Agency (IEA)). The database is subject to the IEA’s Terms and Conditions, available at The goal of the Energy Efficiency Indicators is to illustrate what drives each country’s final energy use in order to track and improve national energy efficiency policies. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 1 file in XLS. The portal files it under Energy efficiency. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is restricted or on request according to the listing; the conditions were not read. The licence is other closed licence (terms not stated in the catalogue entry). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
